effects.does: Opens Clara's AI assistance for the event.

Publish never stores the returned stage uuids (only Save as draft does), so a retry after a failed project PATCH (e.g. 712) POSTs every stage again — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1826-1839 vs 1516-1536

Switching between RFI and RFQ/Auction warns "Switching event mode will reset existing data." and on save clears template, sheet, savings, currencies and ALL project participants — auctionConfiguration.jsx:390-407, 898-903, src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:505-536

Drawer disabled when fromPR, `isEditingAllowed=false` or `isAddNewStage`; variant shows "Variant of product cannot be modified", quantity/unit " 'Quantity Requested' and 'Unit of Measurement' cannot be modified" (quantity still editable when fromPR) — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLine

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345

In project creation `product`, `creator_quantity`, `variant` are locked; PR events also lock READ_ONLY_WIDGETS_IN_PR_TO_AUCTION and `blockEditFromPr` widgets — templateSelection.jsx:248-272

cases.title: Add Columns opens the column selection view
cases.expected: A column selection interface opens. The existing pricing-sheet columns remain visible and additional available columns can be reviewed.
gaps: Verify the complete column-selection interface contents and that all additional available columns can be reviewed.
Verify the exact set of selectable columns or whether already-added columns are disabled in the Add Columns menu.

cases.title: Required pricing-sheet columns are marked
steps: Compare the required markers on each column.
cases.expected: Product, Product Variant, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, Price, Quantity Available, and Total Amount show required markers. GST does not show a required marker.
cases.setup: Open the create-pricing-sheet screen with Items 2 displayed.
gaps: Whether Product, Product Variant, Quantity Requested, Delivery location, Price, Quantity Available, and Total Amount show required markers.
Whether GST omits its required marker.

cases.title: Saving a draft updates the existing draft instead of creating a duplicate
steps: Enter a unique value in Enter the title of the project.
Wait for the save to complete.
Change the value in Enter the title of the project.
cases.expected: The first save creates one draft. The second save updates the same draft with the new title and does not create a second draft.
cases.setup: Open a new unsaved create-pricing-sheet screen with the two existing line items.
gaps: The UI does not expose the draft's persistent identifier, so it cannot prove that the second save updated the same backend record rather than replacing it with a new record having the same title.

cases.title: Publish shows the schedule confirmation before completion
steps: Do not confirm the publish action.
cases.expected: A publish confirmation appears. It shows "Starts on: Now" and an ending time with the 30-minute duration, including the event's vendor and schedule summary. The event is not published until the confirmation is completed.
cases.setup: Open a valid event setup with at least one participant and leave the displayed 30-minute schedule unchanged.
gaps: Exact dynamic ending time corresponding to the 30-minute duration
The specific invited vendor identity in the confirmation summary when the case does not name a vendor
unconfirmed label "30" (expect_text) — not among the labels known from the app nor in the case

cases.title: Publish refuses a project without participants
cases.expected: Publishing stops and the app shows "Please add participants to proceed!".
cases.setup: Enter a valid project title and valid values for all required line-item columns. Leave "Search vendors you want to add" empty.

cases.title: Save as draft creates the initial draft event
cases.expected: The event is saved as a draft. The draft retains the entered title and line-item values.
cases.setup: Enter a project title and valid values for all required line-item columns.

cases.title: Changing the selected template asks for confirmation
cases.expected: The confirmation dialog shows "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" and the confirmation action is labeled "Yes".
cases.setup: Open a pricing sheet that already has a template and populated event data.
gaps: Reliably choose and verify a different template from the template picker.

cases.title: Pricing sheet navigation controls open their sections
steps: Click "Items 2" and verify the item section opens.
Click "Add Columns" and verify the column selector opens.
Click "Add Attachments" and verify the attachment area opens.
Click "Add T&Cs" and verify the terms editor opens.
Click each of "Details", "Price Components", "Participants", "Savings", and "Terms & Conditions".
Click "Now - 02:33 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins )" and verify the schedule editor opens.
cases.expected: Each control opens its matching section or editor without navigating away from the create-pricing-sheet screen.
gaps: Exact matching section identity for every navigation control when the product does not expose a distinct known heading inside the opened overlay.
